title: Ebbmarrow begins
items: The first playable slice: the Prologue and Part 1, The Bared Flats.
Explore Kettle Cove, the bared flats, and the Crab Warren.
Turn-based battles with the Tide: water arts surge at high tide, blades crit at low tide.
Boss: Grandclaw, keeper of the Seal Steps.
Side quests: Gran's Crab Trap, P & M Always, and Procedure Is Procedure.
Pixel art, lighting, music and sound, all generated in code.
Works on phones (touch pad) and computers (keyboard). Saves stay on your device.
